## Summary

Describe the narrowly scoped correction or improvement and link the related issue.

## Evidence and provenance

- Claim, hypothesis, question, or literature IDs affected:
- DOI, PMID, PMCID, guideline, or other supporting source:
- Applicability limits or counterevidence:

## Safety checklist

- [ ] I did not add private medical records, personal identifiers, source PDFs, credentials, or local-only files.
- [ ] I did not present a hypothesis as a diagnosis or add treatment instructions.
- [ ] I preserved evidence polarity, uncertainty, and source-class distinctions.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks under `site/`.
- [ ] I updated the changelog or correction record if the change is substantive.

Unsolicited large analysis changes may be closed in favor of a structured issue first. See `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
